Common Solon Questions

Solon Tree Service FAQ

Six things Solon property owners want to know before booking.

Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Solon?
Solon has a tree preservation ordinance that requires a permit to remove protected trees above set DBH thresholds, with separate categories for residential and commercial properties. Hazard trees follow an expedited process, and the engineering department reviews commercial site work. Roubic routinely coordinates the permit workflow as part of the removal scope.
How fast do you respond in Solon?
Solon is a Tier 1 Roubic service area — priority estimate scheduling during business hours and, for after-hours storm and emergency calls via our 24/7 line, a target of on-site within 2–4 hours inside the primary service area.
How much does tree removal cost in Solon?
Tree removal in Solon typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on tree size, species, access, and permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees with crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and confirmed on-site before you book.
Do you handle commercial and industrial tree work in Solon?
Yes. Solon's industrial-park corridor along Solon Industrial Pkwy is a core part of our Solon work — scheduled commercial pruning, stump grinding, corporate-campus maintenance, and emergency response for B2B accounts, alongside our residential base.
Are you insured to work in Solon?
Yes — Roubic carries general liability and workers-comp insurance. A certificate of insurance is available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs requiring COI submission.
Can I schedule an estimate online for a Solon property?
Yes — fill out the estimate form (click any Get Free Estimate button on this page) with your Solon address, the service needed, and your phone number. Aaron or a Roubic foreman will confirm and schedule the on-site visit within 1 business day.
